description: World Prices by Country. What things cost and how fast prices move, by country and by commodity, in one API. Routes: /gaps (limit, offset); /rank (item, by, order, year, continent, limit, offset); /items (q, kind, limit, offset); /compare (countries*, item, from, to); /summary; /countries (q, continent, limit, offset); /us-states (item, year, order, limit, offset); /commodities (kind, q, sort, limit, offset); /items/{item}; /countries/{iso2} (item, freq, from, to); /commodities/{item} (freq, from, to); /countries/{iso2}/profile. Paid $0.005 USDC per call via x402 (_meta["x402/payment"]); set sample=true for a free 3-row preview.

route.description: One of: /gaps, /rank, /items, /compare, /summary, /countries, /us-states, /commodities, /items/{item}, /countries/{iso2}, /commodities/{item}, /countries/{iso2}/profile. Replace {placeholders} with a value, e.g. /search or /HND.

name: prices
